contentHtml:
Donning a bespoke suit and style, ambition struts down almost every road in Dubai. If you have been eyeing the grooming industry here long and want to start combing through it, a gents salon might be the perfect start. But before you grab your scissors and styling gel and start snipping your way into this lucrative market, let’s tackle the most pressing trim of all — gents salon license cost in Dubai.

In our blog post, we share costs, insights, strategies and insider tips that will have you styling in no time. Other takeaway points include:

  • Barber Shops & Business Plans: The Actual Gents Salon License Costs in Dubai
  • How Much Does It Cost to Launch a Gents Salon in Dubai?
  • The Price of Style: Understanding Gents Salon License Costs in Dubai

Why Open a Gents Salon in Dubai?

The local population loves staying sharp and proper. The demand for premium grooming services is increasing, as a result. Quick trims, beard makeovers or full on grooming packages — men in Dubai are willing to pay for quality services. You’ve a winning formula with the seemingly simple business setup process.

Adding to the diverse customer base in this city are tourists and expats. A successful salon is one that not only gives great haircuts but curates its services and experiences to its clients’ preferences. Fueling the grooming trend is the rise of social media influencers, with men looking for top services to maintain their online presence. This makes your gents salon among the business ideas in UAE with high yet underrated potential. 

Gents Salon License Costs in Dubai: How do the Numbers Add Up?

Let’s talk dirhams or well, how much is going to be that gents salon license cost in Dubai.

Trade Name Registration

First impressions matter. And your salon’s name is no exception. It usually costs around AED 620 to AED 2000 to register a trade name. Add a little creativity to your name to make it original and memorable. Think of a name that resonates with your brand and also appeals to your target clientele.

Initial Approval Fees

Before opening up a shop, you’ll need to get initial approval from the Department of Economic Development. This factors in approximately AED 120 for your gents salon license cost in Dubai.

Professional License Fees

A professional license is the very foundation of your business. The total cost of gents salon license in Dubai takes into account the size and location of your salon. Larger spaces and high traffic areas might push this cost higher. But the return on investment often justifies the expense.

Commercial Space

A salon needs a prime location to attract footfall. Expect to spend anywhere between an estimated AED 15,000 and AED 50,000 annually for a decent space in a good neighborhood. We’re talking about downtown hotspots, bustling malls, or trendy areas where your clientele frequently visits. Want to check out alternatives? Pair your research with ideas for dropshipping business in UAE to optimize your costs and keep your cash flow healthy.

Fit Out and Interior Design

Dubai’s clientele loves luxury. So you’ll need to budget for those high class interiors. A well designed space is an investment that pays off in customer loyalty. Create an inviting atmosphere with sleek chairs, ambient lighting, and modern fixtures. After all, a well groomed space mirrors your services.

Visa and Sponsorship Costs

Planning to hire staff? Employee visas and sponsorships will cost in thousands per person. Ensure your compliance with UAE labour law and have a solid employment contract already in place to avoid future stress. Hire trained professionals to provide exceptional service from day one.

Hidden Costs to Watch Out For Barber Shop License Cost in Dubai:

The main expenses around the gents salon license cost in Dubai usually grab all the attention. That doesn’t mean overlooking these hidden expenses:

Marketing and Branding

Digital campaigns and social media ads can set you back by a few thousand dirhams  initially. But hey, no pain, no gain. Create an engaging online presence to improve your brand’s visibility.

Health and Safety Approvals

Compliance with Dubai Municipality regulations is necessary. Inspections and certifications could cost a significant amount. These certifications verify you meet hygiene and operational standards that are essential in the grooming industry.

Utility Deposits

Setting up electricity, water, and internet could put a dent on your startup costs. Consider these costs beforehand as part of setting up a functional workspace.

How to Reduce the Gents Salon License Cost in Dubai?

These are a few hacks if you want to trim the fat from your budget for gents salon license cost in Dubai:

Start Small

Begin with a compact salon in a developing area. Establish your brand. Scale as you grow. Reduce rental costs with smaller spaces when you are starting out. 

Leverage Free Zones

This one’s probably rare for salons. But you might want to check out some of the cost effective solutions for your business models offered by Dubai’s free zones. Keep an eye out for zones with flexible regulations.

Bundle Services

Combine grooming with other offerings such as spa treatments to maximize your revenue streams. Bundling creates value for customers and at the same time, boosts your profits. For inspiration, look at other business owners making the most out of  business opportunities in Dubai.

Required Documents for Obtaining a Barber Shop License in Dubai

To establish and operate a barber shop in Dubai, you must submit several key documents as part of the licensing process. The core requirements typically include:

  • A valid Emirates ID or passport copy

  • A valid UAE residence visa (if applicable)

  • Passport copies of all shareholders (if the business has multiple owners)

  • A duly completed trade license application form

Depending on your business activity and location, you may also be required to submit additional documentation. This could include health and safety approvals, a tenancy contract (Ejari), initial trade name reservation, and approval from relevant authorities such as the Dubai Department of Economic Development (DED) and the Dubai Municipality. In some cases, clearance from the Dubai Health Authority (DHA) may also be necessary to ensure compliance with hygiene and public health standards.

Steps to Get Your Gents Salon License in Dubai 2025:

Follow these steps:

Choose a Business Activity

Clearly specify your salon’s activities. Think, haircuts, beard grooming, or spa services. A focused business activity simplifies the licensing process.

Reserve Your Trade Name

Select a catchy and memorable name that follows cultural sensitivities. A strong brand identity can set you apart from your competitors.

Secure a Location

Submit your lease agreement along with a layout plan approved by the Dubai Municipality. Right location attracts walk-in customers like no other.

Apply for the License

Submit your application to the DED. Pay the required gents salon license cost in Dubai. Set your business into motion officially by completing these requirements.

Start Hiring

Now that you are licensed, it’s time to hire staff. Skilled employees are the backbone of a successful salon. Follow employment contract UAE guidelines for all the contracts. 

The ROI: Is It Worth It?

The Dubai gents salon license cost might seem steep at first. But the city’s economy and high disposable income levels make it a worthwhile investment.

A busy salon with loyal clients walking in and out as you enjoy steady profits and the joy of being your own boss. Plus, Dubai’s growing market ensures a constant flow of new customers, making your business sustainable and profitable.

With some well thought out strategies on your hand, even hidden costs turn into prospects. Offer loyalty programs. Partner with local influencers to enhance your brand’s appeal. Dubai’s business-friendly policies also make it easier to scale operations by opening doors to regional expansion.
